name: Bollinger washout reversion in chop
rationale: A deeply negative Bollinger z-score (bb_z) flags a statistically unusual downside dislocation. Conditioning that washout on a LOW-ADX (non-trending, choppy) regime is the crux: in chop, an extreme band excursion is noise that snaps back to the mean, whereas in a strong downtrend the same excursion is a falling knife. So this fades stretched price ONLY when ADX confirms there is no dominant trend driving it. Structurally distinct from the vol-gated washout spec (ADX regime filter, not realized-vol) and from RSI momentum reversion (band-relative, not momentum-relative). Disconfirmer: exit when bb_z reverts back toward zero (the snap-back played out), or the stop fires if the washout was the first leg of a real breakdown.
catalyst: statistically unusual downside band excursion in a non-trending regime
